research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: empty frozen occupation list is not zero experience. First speech and school-affiliated biography establish substantive pre-parliament jobs absent from extract. Local annual report and association records distinguish employment from elected/governance offices.

Follow-up: SSTUWA title and dates/hours, earlier UK/Australian employment and study, exact school payroll entity/hours/leave, all gaps and overlap with council service; association appointment/end and pay basis; school-placement details. School annual records/payroll or legitimate professional profile would be strongest next sources.

Searches included official/member material, school/employer sites, council/association annual reports, full-time terms and union employment. Unrelated actress, US lawyer, NZ executive assistant, health-care marketer and namesake professional profiles not adopted. School-site full-time mayor descriptor cannot establish registrar hours.

Own20-year public-service marketing description refers to political/community service, not codebook public-service employment. Generic summaries ending mayor role on election day contradicted by local authority June2022 resignation. Pre-first-campaign secondary school chronology retained as gap, not used to alter primary year range.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: council annual report resolves deputy-mayor subterm; 2015 appointment announcement bounds WALGA deputy presidency; public professional profile refines registrar start to September 1999. School and hospital organisation biographies add governance and explicit volunteer activities.

SSTUWA employment title/dates and UK work remain unresolved after exact-name union searches. Do not substitute union presidents’ terms for her employment. LGIS indexed news lead returned an error page, and unrelated namesake profiles were discarded. Registrar profile endpoint/full-time status remains inaccessible (999); seek school personnel records or accessible professional CV. WALGA special-meeting minutes, LGIS appointment/end and school-board tenure remain follow-up leads.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: publicly indexed LinkedIn search text now exposes the complete Peter Moyes Anglican Community School range, September 1999 to September 2011. The end month is adopted at month precision; the profile still does not establish hours, leave, payroll entity or full-time status. Fresh exact-name SSTUWA searches yielded no attributable role title or dates, so that union spell and earlier UK/Australian employment remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Primary LGIS14April2021 publication verifies board observation and member-owned scheme structure; no personal term boundary inferred. Indexed City13December2011 minutes add specified elected-member training units without asserting diploma completion; direct access403 recovered index. Corrected source14 metadata to match already-supported3October registrar endpoint. Exact-name SSTUWA and registrar full-time searches still yield no attributable personal employment hours/title/terms. Remaining leads: historical union personnel, original registrar work arrangement, LGIS charter/appointment and early UK/Australian work.
